newsitem.title: USA: Thermadyne adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Thermadyne adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Thermadyne Holdings Corp said Thursday its directors adopted a shareholder rights plan designed to protect stockholders and assure that they receive fair and equal treatment in the event of any proposed takeover of the company.
Thermadyne said its directors are not aware of any imminent proposal, hostile or otherwise, to acquire control of the company. Thermadyne makes cutting and welding products.

Terms of the rights plan provide for a distribution of one right for each share of common stock of the company to holders of record at the close of business on May 5, 1997. The rights will become exercisable only if a person or group accumulates 10 percent or more of the company's outstanding voting stock or announces an offer that would result in ownership by a person or group of 10 percent or more of the voting stock. Unless
earlier redeemed, the rights will expire on May 5, 2007. Each right will entitle the holder to buy one share of the company's stock at a price of $150.
The rights plan should encourage anyone seeking to acquire the company to treat all stockholders equally and to negotiate with the board prior to a takeover attempt, it said.
